name: notification-stack
title: Notification stack
description: Notifications folded into a neat pile that fans out into a list, each one dismissable.

a11y.text: Show all and Show less is a native button, shown only with more than one item. Each Dismiss button is a native button. While the stack is folded only the first card has one.

The stack is a section labelled by labels.title, with an ordered list. The toggle sets aria-expanded and aria-controls. While folded, every card after the first is aria-hidden. Each dismiss button is named Dismiss: <title>, and the icons are aria-hidden.
The stack is wrapped in MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user, so Motion follows the system setting for the fold and fan-out.
